messages:
Jordan: kicking off canary for release v2.3.1 to eu-west now — traffic 5% on Dedicated pool. deploy-bot: started rollout job #5621 -> https://deploys.redwood/5621 :rocket: SLO-watch will post updates here.

deploy-bot: canary started at 1739001234, route=eu-west, variant=v2.3.1, traffic=5%

Maya: watching SLO dashboards (p95 / 5xx). @Alex can you watch embed-route specifically?

Alex: on it. dashboard link: https://console.redwood/slo/embed-route — p95 looks fine, but 5xx just ticked to ~0.62% (alert threshold 0.5%)

SLO-alert-bot: [ALERT] embed-route 5xx rate breached (0.62%) — 1m window — severity: warn

Samir: checking logs, I see a cluster of upstream 502s from model-quantizer-3 around the same time. snippet: ```2026-03-21T12:34:01Z error: upstream 502 model-quantizer-3 recv EOF```

Jordan: hmm. Is this correlated with the quantized kernel push in this canary? If it's just embeds, we can pin that route back to v2.3.0 and keep the rest of the canary going.

Maya: propose: HOLD canary for embed-route + PIN embed-route -> v2.3.0. That avoids a full rollback and keeps rollouts on other routes. Any objections?

Alex: no objections. Pin command ready: `deployctl pin --route=embed-route --version=v2.3.0 --reason='canary-5xx-spike'` — executing now.

deploy-bot: pin started... pin successful. embed-route pinned to v2.3.0 at 1739001300 — traffic reverted, monitoring continuing.

Jordan: great. No full rollback. Samir, can you collect traces + tail logs for model-quantizer-3 so eng-runtime can debug kernel perf/regression?

Samir: grabbing traces and perf samples now. Uploaded initial flamegraph + spans: https://s3.redwood/traces/5621-flame.svg — early signal: quantized kernel tail latency +30ms on some shards.

Maya: also noticed a small token-rate dip on Dedicated pool while this was happening. Opening a short incident/triage ticket and adding a line to the release notes: "Temporarily pinned embed-route to v2.3.0 due to 5xx spike during canary".

Jordan: cadence: hold canary on embed-route until eng-runtime verifies patch. Continue canary (5%) on other routes. Re-evaluate for a re-roll after metrics stable for 10m. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

Alex: :thumbsup: will keep an eye on p95 + 5xx and post updates.

deploy-bot: monitor subscription: added eng-runtime, eng-ml, oncall to rollout-5621 channel.

Maya: tagging release notes PR here: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/314 — adding context and mitigation steps.

Jordan: summary for execs if asked: canary detected embed 5xx bump, we pinned that route back to stable, no customer impact detected beyond spike, investigating quantizer kernel behavior, will follow up with RCA.

Samir: I'll post a short trace summary in this thread when I have correlation across shards.

Jordan: ok closing until next update — anyone can re-open thread with new signals.
